meta.name: saga-orchestration
meta.description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

copy.tagline: 让跨系统操作在失败时自动撤销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的操作牵动多个系统,一步失败就要全部回退。
copy.tagline_en: Roll back failed steps across multiple systems to keep data consistent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your operation spans multiple systems and needs full rollback when any part fails

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 saga 模式为跨微服务的分布式事务做编排设计：给出有序步骤、动作与补偿命令、每步超时配置和卡住 saga 的监控，并帮你排查补偿不完成等问题。
howto.when: 当 2PC 不可用却要跨微服务实现分布式事务、为横跨多服务的订单流程设计补偿动作，或排查生产环境卡住的 saga 状态时触发。

say.text: 帮我为下订单流程设计 saga，覆盖库存、支付、发货三步及各自补偿
say.note: 产出有序步骤与补偿命令

say.text: 我的 saga 卡在 COMPENSATING 状态，查查补偿为什么没完成
say.note: 排查未发布完成事件的补偿处理器

say.text: 给 create_shipment 这类慢步骤配每步超时，别用全局超时
say.note: 按步骤类型配置超时，避免误触发补偿

howto.what_en: Claude designs saga orchestrations for distributed transactions: ordered steps with action and compensation commands, per-step timeout configuration, plus monitoring for stuck sagas and DLQ recovery.
howto.when_en: Use when 2PC is unavailable for cross-service transactions, when designing compensations for order workflows across inventory, payment and shipping, or when debugging stuck saga states in production.

say_en.text: Design a saga for my order flow, with compensation for each step
say_en.note: Produces ordered steps and compensation commands

say_en.text: My saga is stuck in COMPENSATING - find why compensation never completes
say_en.note: Traces compensation handlers that publish no result

say_en.text: Set per-step timeouts for slow steps like create_shipment, not a global timeout
